correctness.rationale: The global color sum kills precisely the compulsory nonbalanced class before evaluating balanced modes; for balanced modes the n−1 suffixes form a free coordinate system. Properness is nonzero increments with their sum nonzero, and subtracting sum-zero increments by character orthogonality gives the stated signed expression. At a balanced zero with b<c, the 2-adic valuation is b on the right and a+1 on the left; division leaves (−2)^(c−b)=−2, hence c=b+1. If b=c all three exponents coincide. This accounts for all three disjoint histogram patterns, and the multinomial count, Fourier rank/nullity, and Stirling asymptotic follow. No exceptional n=3 normalization change is needed.
